records.text: An anonymous online post forwarded through Kolvet and Erika was read as saying, “we are going to get Charlie Kirk and Candace Owens involved in a public feud”; its authorship was unverified.
records.speaker: Anonymous authors of quoted 2019 internet post (Ep 389; identities unverified)

appearances.snippet: So it starts with this November 12th, 2019. And Andrew (Andrew Kolvet) says, just making sure you see this. And he forwards a message from E. ... Written, the date and the time are written European style: 12/11/19. It's actually 11/12/19, American standards. It's November 12th, and 13:35 is 1:35 p.m. So that's something that I'm pointing out because it's weird. But the message is from Erika (Erika Kirk). I didn't know at the time because I didn't have her on Telegram, and I didn't know who E (Erika Kirk) was, and he writes, quote, ... Or he shares, he forwards, quotes, we are going to get Charlie Kirk and Candace Owens involved in a public feud.

records.text: An anonymous forwarded post proposed using charged questions to make Kirk criticize Owens and flattering Owens while promoting a story that Kirk feared and undermined her, to provoke a public attack; authorship and the promoted story were unverified.
records.speaker: Anonymous authors of quoted 2019 internet post (Ep 389; identities unverified)

appearances.snippet: And then he says she found this too, and he includes this. We need Groypers to ask Charlie (Charlie Kirk), sorry, I say so, but I would have to say charge questions. ... We need, thank you, give me full screen. We need Groypers to ask Charlie (Charlie Kirk) charged questions about Candace Owens and get him to criticize her. ... At the same time, we need to fluff Candace Owens' ego while subtly driving home the fact that she was driven out of Turning Point USA because Kirk (Charlie Kirk). ... Kirk (Charlie Kirk) feared her. And since she was driven out, Kirk (Charlie Kirk) has been working behind the scenes to undermine her. ... We need to fan these flames until Candace finally chimps out and the R word, it's like an aggressive R word, Kirk (Charlie Kirk) publicly.
